tofua.text: Tofua: steep-sided cone with summit caldera, western Haʻapai
Hired boat and steep one-hour climb to crater views
Connected to Kao by undersea (submarine) ridge
Climb leads to the crater rim and views of Kao
tofua.fix: Source says views of the crater and Kao; 'rim' is implied, not stated. Prefer 'views of the crater and Kao'.

tofua.text: No lava lake, eruption or smoke in any variant (transient)
Cost: free / costBasis open / no ticketUrl
tofua.source: wikivoyage Haʻapai, tongatourism free-activities (re-read: no fee; boat hire is transport, not a price)

uoleva.text: Sand-cay island in Lifuka district, almost uninhabited, five small resorts, clean quiet beaches

uoleva.fix: Evidence says only 'Lifuka district'. Use 'in Lifuka district'.
Boat is a reasonable reading of island trips, but no source says so outright; safe to keep, or drop.

uoleva.source: tongatourism free-activities (listed free activity); no fee found

niuafoou.text: Northernmost island of Tonga, volcanic rim around two crater lakes
Hike craters, swim in freshwater lakes

vai-lahi.text: Freshwater crater lake, 23 m above sea level, four islands (one visible only when water drops)

vai-lahi.fix: Source says most of the inner walls; ok but 'ringed by forested walls' slightly overstates.

Source only says locals may be able to take you to a vantage point for a photo, not that the lake is reached with guides. Use 'with vantage points locals can show you' or drop; variants 1 and 3 are fine.

vai-lahi.text: Figures 4 km wide / 84 m deep not used in drafts
vai-lahi.source: wikipedia Niuafoʻou excerpt actually gives 4 km wide and 84 m deep
vai-lahi.fix: Researcher said unverified; the bundle's Wikipedia page carries them, so they could be used. Not needed.

niuatoputapu.text: Sacred Island, volcanic, three villages, white beaches and lagoons
Thatched fales; freshwater spring dip at Hihifo; steady steep climb to high point with views of Tafahi cone

niuatoputapu.source: https://tongapocketguide.com/best-things-to-do-on-niuatoputapu re-read: only 'NZ$50' hits are ferry/guesthouse ad widgets, not a spot price

tafahi.text: 656 m cone-shaped volcano, steep climb, Samoa visible on a fine day
9 km from Niuatoputapu, one village, north (NNE) of it

tafahi.fix: Source says it is best to get a guide; 'you climb with a guide' is a recommendation, not a requirement. Say 'best with a guide'.
Outboards are what fishermen use daily between the islands; visitors 'negotiate a boat ride'. Say 'reached by local boat'.

tafahi.text: Cost: free / open / no ticketUrl; boat ride price not given (transport)
